model.module_text:
---- MODULE CompileOnce ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Models

VARIABLES status, result, firstKind, firstResult, settlementCount,
          workerTerminated, timer, lateKind

vars == <<status, result, firstKind, firstResult, settlementCount,
          workerTerminated, timer, lateKind>>

Kinds == {"none", "done", "failure", "error", "timeout"}

RejectionKinds == {"failure", "error", "timeout"}

Results == Models \cup {"none", "failure", "error", "timeout"}

\* Unratified candidate F1/A: an expired one-shot timer counts as released.
\* One invocation, after successful Worker/timer/handler setup and postMessage.
\* An action delivers one callback and observes it after the promise checkpoint;
\* callbacks run to completion, with no interleaving inside JavaScript handlers.
\* Worker construction/postMessage and mocked host APIs succeed in this scope.
\* firstKind/firstResult are the driver's immutable record of the first input;
\* status/result are observed on the returned promise, not resolver-call counts.
\* Rejection results identify the winning failure kind, not Error object identity.
\* timer records armed, fired without clearTimeout, or explicitly clearTimeout'd.
\* workerTerminated is read from the mock, and settlementCount counts actual
\* promise transitions; repeated terminate/clear/resolve/reject calls are allowed.
\* Late actions let the driver invoke retained callbacks even after cleanup.

TypeOK ==
    /\ status \in {"pending", "resolved", "rejected"}
    /\ result \in Results
    /\ firstKind \in Kinds
    /\ firstResult \in Results
    /\ settlementCount \in 0..2
    /\ workerTerminated \in BOOLEAN
    /\ timer \in {"armed", "expired", "cleared"}
    /\ lateKind \in Kinds

SettlesOnce ==
    /\ settlementCount <= 1
    /\ (status = "pending" <=> settlementCount = 0)

FirstOutcomeWins ==
    status # "pending" => result = firstResult

CorrectDisposition ==
    /\ (firstKind = "none" => status = "pending")
    /\ (firstKind = "done" => status = "resolved")
    /\ (firstKind \in RejectionKinds => status = "rejected")

WorkerReleased ==
    status # "pending" => workerTerminated

TimerReleased ==
    status # "pending" => timer \in {"expired", "cleared"}

DoneWins == status = "resolved" /\ firstKind = "done"

FailureWins == status = "rejected" /\ firstKind = "failure"

ErrorWins == status = "rejected" /\ firstKind = "error"

TimeoutWins == status = "rejected" /\ firstKind = "timeout"

LateDoneIgnored ==
    /\ firstKind = "timeout"
    /\ lateKind = "done"
    /\ status = "rejected"
    /\ result = "timeout"

LateTimeoutIgnored ==
    /\ firstKind = "done"
    /\ lateKind = "timeout"
    /\ status = "resolved"
    /\ result = firstResult

EventuallySettles == <> (status # "pending")

Init ==
    /\ status = "pending"
    /\ result = "none"
    /\ firstKind = "none"
    /\ firstResult = "none"
    /\ settlementCount = 0
    /\ workerTerminated = FALSE
    /\ timer = "armed"
    /\ lateKind = "none"

Done(model) ==
    /\ status = "pending"
    /\ model \in Models
    /\ status' = "resolved"
    /\ result' = model
    /\ firstKind' = "done"
    /\ firstResult' = model
    /\ settlementCount' = 1
    /\ workerTerminated' = TRUE
    /\ timer' = "cleared"
    /\ UNCHANGED lateKind

Failure ==
    /\ status = "pending"
    /\ status' = "rejected"
    /\ result' = "failure"
    /\ firstKind' = "failure"
    /\ firstResult' = "failure"
    /\ settlementCount' = 1
    /\ workerTerminated' = TRUE
    /\ timer' = "cleared"
    /\ UNCHANGED lateKind

WorkerError ==
    /\ status = "pending"
    /\ status' = "rejected"
    /\ result' = "error"
    /\ firstKind' = "error"
    /\ firstResult' = "error"
    /\ settlementCount' = 1
    /\ workerTerminated' = TRUE
    /\ timer' = "cleared"
    /\ UNCHANGED lateKind

Timeout ==
    /\ status = "pending"
    /\ timer = "armed"
    /\ status' = "rejected"
    /\ result' = "timeout"
    /\ firstKind' = "timeout"
    /\ firstResult' = "timeout"
    /\ settlementCount' = 1
    /\ workerTerminated' = TRUE
    /\ timer' = "expired"
    /\ UNCHANGED lateKind

TimeoutProgress == WF_vars(Timeout)

LateDone(model) ==
    /\ status # "pending"
    /\ model \in Models
    /\ lateKind' = "done"
    /\ timer' = "cleared"
    /\ workerTerminated' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<status, result, firstKind, firstResult, settlementCount>>

LateFailure ==
    /\ status # "pending"
    /\ lateKind' = "failure"
    /\ timer' = "cleared"
    /\ workerTerminated' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<status, result, firstKind, firstResult, settlementCount>>

LateError ==
    /\ status # "pending"
    /\ lateKind' = "error"
    /\ timer' = "cleared"
    /\ workerTerminated' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<status, result, firstKind, firstResult, settlementCount>>

LateTimeout ==
    /\ status # "pending"
    /\ lateKind' = "timeout"
    /\ workerTerminated' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<status, result, firstKind, firstResult,
                  settlementCount, timer>>

Finished == status # "pending" /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ (\E model \in Models : Done(model))
    \/ Failure
    \/ WorkerError
    \/ Timeout
    \/ (\E model \in Models : LateDone(model))
    \/ LateFailure
    \/ LateError
    \/ LateTimeout
    \/ Finished

\* These mutations are deliberately absent from Next.
BugSettleTwice ==
    /\ status # "pending"
    /\ settlementCount = 1
    /\ settlementCount' = 2
    /\ UNCHANGED <<status, result, firstKind, firstResult,
                  workerTerminated, timer, lateKind>>

BugLateModelReplacesWinner ==
    /\ status = "resolved"
    /\ \E model \in Models : model # firstResult /\ result' = model
    /\ lateKind' = "done"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<status, firstKind, firstResult, settlementCount,
                  workerTerminated, timer>>

BugFailureResolves ==
    /\ status = "pending"
    /\ status' = "resolved"
    /\ result' = "failure"
    /\ firstKind' = "failure"
    /\ firstResult' = "failure"
    /\ settlementCount' = 1
    /\ workerTerminated' = TRUE
    /\ timer' = "cleared"
    /\ UNCHANGED lateKind

BugWorkerLeaks ==
    /\ status = "pending"
    /\ status' = "rejected"
    /\ result' = "failure"
    /\ firstKind' = "failure"
    /\ firstResult' = "failure"
    /\ settlementCount' = 1
    /\ timer' = "cleared"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<workerTerminated, lateKind>>

BugTimerLeaks ==
    /\ status = "pending"
    /\ status' = "rejected"
    /\ result' = "error"
    /\ firstKind' = "error"
    /\ firstResult' = "error"
    /\ settlementCount' = 1
    /\ workerTerminated' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<timer, lateKind>>

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
====

rules.says: One compile starts with its worker and timer ready, and each step delivers a callback or leaves a finished compile unchanged.

rules.name: SettlesOnce
rules.says: The returned promise leaves pending at most once, regardless of how many callbacks arrive.

rules.name: FirstOutcomeWins
rules.says: The promise retains the first callback's model or rejection cause despite every later callback.

rules.name: CorrectDisposition
rules.says: The first callback resolves the promise if it reports done and rejects it if it reports failure, a worker error or a timeout.

rules.name: WorkerReleased
rules.says: The worker has been terminated whenever the promise is settled.

rules.name: TimerReleased
rules.says: Whenever the promise is settled, clearTimeout has been called on its timer, including when timeout wins.

rules.name: TypeOK
rules.says: The promise, first callback, settlement count, worker, timer and late callback records always have their declared types.

rules.name: DoneWins
rules.says: A done message can arrive first and resolve the promise with its model.

rules.name: FailureWins
rules.says: A failure message can arrive first and reject the promise.

rules.name: ErrorWins
rules.says: A worker error can arrive first and reject the promise.

rules.name: TimeoutWins
rules.says: The timer can fire first and reject the promise.

rules.name: LateDoneIgnored
rules.says: A done message delivered after timeout can leave the timeout rejection unchanged.

rules.name: LateTimeoutIgnored
rules.says: A retained timeout callback delivered after success can leave the returned model unchanged.

rules.name: EventuallySettles
rules.says: The promise eventually settles, even if the worker never reports a result.

rules.name: TimeoutProgress
rules.says: If compilation remains pending, its continuously enabled timeout callback eventually runs.

rules.name: BugSettleTwice
rules.says: A faulty promise changes from pending to settled a second time.

rules.name: BugLateModelReplacesWinner
rules.says: A late done message replaces the model that already won the race.

rules.name: BugFailureResolves
rules.says: A failure message incorrectly resolves the promise.

rules.name: BugWorkerLeaks
rules.says: A failure rejects the promise without terminating the worker.

rules.name: BugTimerLeaks
rules.says: A worker error rejects the promise while leaving its timer armed.

rules.name: BugTimeoutSkipsClear
rules.says: The timeout rejects and terminates the worker without explicitly clearing its already fired timer, as the current code does.
